building: Morgan J. Burke Boilermaker Aquatic Center
scope: Only this building asset and audit/batchC_boilermaker_aquatic_r1. No master, README, manifest, shared indexes/scripts, other buildings, commit or push.

geometry_changes.change: Added opaque brick/concrete GIS-aligned envelope, converted the 57 full-height transparent panes into 1.8m reflective ribbon panes, added north portal/doors/canopy/sign and removed the opposite generic threshold/name cue.
geometry_changes.source_support: Google Street View panorama captured July 2023 shows the north hall as red brick with lower ribbon glazing, centered entrance/canopy and building name.
geometry_changes.limitations: Only the north facade is directly checked. Window dimensions/divisions, other elevations, exact wall height and roof section remain estimates.

geometry_changes.change: Replaced one full-footprint deck slab with seven deck patches around two basins; competition pool waterline is 0.19m above asset origin and model basin depth is 2.2m.
geometry_changes.limitations: Basin depth/width, deck layout and dimensions not stated by the source remain schematic.

geometry_changes.change: Added separate 6-lane 26-yard dive pool with 17ft depth, five diving platform elevations and four springboards.
geometry_changes.source_support: Purdue RecWell aquatics and facility pages.
geometry_changes.limitations: Well width/precise location, tower supports, and platform form remain schematic without a dimensioned plan.

geometry_changes.change: Added the documented 12-person spa; corrected brick reuse on lane markers, lane markings, blocks, platforms and seating accents; added Purdue-gold material.
geometry_changes.source_support: Purdue facility fact sheet and existing material palette.
